label: Ātma-Nivedana Song Three
title: mānasa deho geho jo kichu mor
incipit: mānasa, deho, geho, jo kichu mor
metaDescription: Ātma-Nivedana Song Three: (mānasa deho geho jo kichu mor) of Śaraṇāgati (‘Surrender’) written by Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura in 1893. This songbook contains 50 songs detailing the six symptoms of surrender unto the lotus feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

translit: mānasa, deho, geho, jo kichu mor
verses.translation: Mind, body, family, and whatever else may be mine, I have surrendered at Your lotus feet, O youthful son of Nanda!
deva: मानस, देहो, गेहो, जो किछु मोर्
bengali: মানস, দেহো, গেহো, জো কিছু মোর্

translit: dāy mama gelā, tuwā o-pada varaṇe
verses.translation: In good fortune or in bad, in life or in death, all my difficulties have disappeared by accepting those feet of Yours as my only shelter.
deva: दाय् मम गेला, तुवा ओ-पद वरणे
bengali: দায্ মম গেলা, তুবা ও-পদ বরণে

verses.translation: Slay me or protect me as You wish, for You have full authority over Your eternal servant.
If it is Your wish that I be born again, then may I take birth in the home of Your devotee.
May I be born again even as a worm, as long as I remain Your devotee. I have no desire to be born as a Brahmā averse to You.*
I yearn for the company of that devotee who is completely devoid of all desire for worldly enjoyment or liberation.
Father, mother, lover, son, Lord, preceptor, and husband-You are everything to me.
Bhaktivinoda says, “O Kāna, please hear me! O Lord of Rādhā, You are my life and soul!”

titleDeva: मानस देहो गेहो जो किछु मोर्
titleBengali: মানস দেহো গেহো জো কিছু মোর্
